verdict.backSoon: This point comes back later today, so it is fresh before it fades.
verdict.scheduled: This point comes back when you are about to forget it.

quiz.title: Quiz
quiz.lead: Questions written from your own documents. Every answer comes with an explanation that cites the page it was taken from, and you can overrule the marking when it gets you wrong.
quiz.noKb: There is nothing to ask about yet: no knowledge base has an indexed document.
quiz.topicPlaceholder: Leave empty to cover the whole knowledge base
quiz.cost: Runs on the model you route to Quizzes in Settings, on your own account.
quiz.dropped: {{count}} citation was removed because no passage backed it.
quiz.dropped_other: {{count}} citations were removed because no passage backed them.

bank.title: Question bank
bank.lead: Every question you have generated, with your last answer. Unanswered ones can be answered here.
bank.empty: No questions match. Write some from the Quiz page.
bank.practise: Practise the ones you got wrong

mastery.title: Mastery
mastery.lead: A path turns one knowledge base and one goal into modules of knowledge points. Each point is reviewed on a spaced-repetition schedule, and a module is done only when the evidence says so.
mastery.nothingDue: Nothing is due. Points you get wrong come back the same day; points you know come back later.
mastery.goalPlaceholder: What you want to be able to do

path.diagnosticLead: One question per knowledge point, spread across modules. Your answers set where each point starts.
path.proposalLead: Your model proposed this from the outline of your documents. Edit it, drop what you do not need, then approve it.
path.noProposal: The model did not propose a plan. Try again from the path's page.
path.unplanned: This path has no approved plan yet.
path.noErrors: No open mistakes on this path.
path.archiveConfirm: Archive this path? Its history is kept, but it stops appearing in your due list.
path.explainGate: Concept and design points need an explanation in your own words before their module is done.

session.nothingDue: Nothing is due on this path right now. Come back when a point is due, or take the diagnostic again.
session.notPlanned: This path has no approved plan yet. Approve one from the path's page first.
session.stopped: The next question could not be prepared.

errors.emptyPlan: Keep at least one module with one knowledge point.

practice.title: Practise your mistakes
practice.lead: The questions you got wrong, one at a time. A mistake counts as fixed after two right answers on different days, so one you answered right today comes back tomorrow.

status.review: right once, once more to fix it

practice.done: That was the last one for now.
practice.empty: Nothing to practise. When you answer a question wrong, in a quiz or a mastery session, it waits here until you have got it right on two different days.

learn.label: Learn
learn.stale: Sources changed: a document this cites has been updated since it was written.
learn.rewrite: Rewrite it from the current sources
learn.failed: The explanation could not be written.

explain.label: Explain it back
explain.unjudged: This explanation could not be judged
explain.judgedWrong: Judged wrong? Count it the other way
explain.disputedPassed: You disputed the verdict: counted as explained, on your word.
explain.disputedFailed: You disputed the verdict: counted as not yet explained, on your word.
explain.requestFailed: The explanation could not be checked.
explain.overrideFailed: Your correction could not be saved.

exams.title: Mock exams
exams.lead: Upload a past paper. AnyLearn lists its questions for you to check, then writes a mock exam with the same types, difficulty and marks from one of your knowledge bases. You take it against the clock, it is marked, and what you get wrong waits in Practice.

upload.title: Upload a past paper
upload.hint: PDF, Word (.docx), text or a photo (PNG, JPEG); up to 20 MB and 40 pages. It is read by the model you route to Parse documents (or from its own text layer) and its questions are listed by your Quizzes model. It is not added to any knowledge base.

exams.noExams: No mock exams yet. Review a paper and mark it ready to make one.
exams.cost: {{count}} items: one call each on your Quizzes model, up to {{calls}} if every item needs a repair.
exams.capped: Only the first {{max}} questions are used.
exams.confirmDelete: Delete this mock exam? Its questions stay in your question bank.
exams.confirmDeletePaper: Delete this paper and its questions list? Mock exams made from it are kept.

review.lead: Check each question against the paper: fix its type, marks or text, and delete anything that is not a question. A mock exam copies exactly what is here.
review.progress: Step {{done}} of {{total}} · {{billed}} calls billed so far
review.failed: The paper could not be read.
review.title: Title
review.optionsHint: One option per line; they are labelled A, B, C… in order.
review.seeOriginal: The figure is in the original paper.
review.isReady: Ready: you can make mock exams from this paper.
review.readyHint: Mark it ready when every question matches the paper.
review.fixFirst: {{count}} question needs fixing before this paper is ready.
review.fixFirst_other: {{count}} questions need fixing before this paper is ready.

generate.title: Writing your mock exam
generate.progress: Item {{done}} of {{total}} · {{billed}} calls billed so far

ready.title: Ready
ready.hint: The clock starts when you press Start. Answers are saved as you type; you can hand in late, and it will say so.

take.notSaved: Not saved. The next change tries again
take.partial: Marking stopped after {{marked}} of {{total}} answers. Your answers are kept; press the button to mark the rest.
take.submitHint: Marking uses your Quizzes model for short, fill-in and written answers; multiple choice and true/false are marked exactly.
take.confirmUnanswered: {{count}} question has no answer. Hand in anyway?
take.confirmUnanswered_other: {{count}} questions have no answer. Hand in anyway?

result.title: Result
result.late: Handed in after the time limit.
result.practise: {{count}} answer is waiting in Practice until you get it right on two different days.
result.practise_other: {{count}} answers are waiting in Practice until you get them right on two different days.

review.title: Review everything due
review.lead: One question at a time from every path you are studying. Each one comes from a different subject than the last, so you switch topics as you go.
review.nothingDue: Nothing is due on any path right now. Come back when a point is due.
